articles.title: Live news: Nvidia slides on CEO allegations as bitcoin hovers just above its 200-day average
articles.description: Neocloud stocks retreat after Friday’s rally, while gold holds above $4,000 and bitcoin trades near $74,000.

articles.title: Coinbase gets full U.S. trust charter from federal banking regulator
articles.description: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency elevated the biggest U.S. exchange's trust status from conditional to a full-fledged charter, the company said.

articles.title: U.S. inflation, corporate earnings: Crypto Week Ahead
articles.description: Your look at what’s coming in the week starting Nov. 9.

articles.title: SpaceX proposes a $24 billion Texas supercomputer worth 17 times its bitcoin pile
articles.description: The $24 billion project, which includes an AI supercomputer in Texas with its own gas-fired power plant, is about 17 times the value of SpaceX's bitcoin holdings.

articles.title: Solana moves to scrap the transaction feature used in the $270 million Drift hack
articles.description: A draft proposal would end the 'durable nonces' feature no earlier than May 5, 2027, forcing custodians that sign offline to rebuild how they move coins.

articles.title: Two rival Ethereum proposals aim to stop Glamsterdam breaking old contracts
articles.description: The proposals aim to keep Ethereum’s planned gas changes from breaking existing contracts, using different approaches to what contracts see and what users pay.

articles.title: Binance's bitcoin mining pool finds just one block in a week as shutdown nears
articles.description: The exchange's once significant mining operation has nearly disappeared from Bitcoin's block-production rankings ahead of its November 10 closure.

articles.title: Bitcoin drops, then pops as Nvidia cheating scandal and failed Iran talks trigger volatility
articles.description: Volatile price action has once again liquidated leveraged bullish plays worth millions.

articles.title: What the election results mean for crypto: State of Crypto
articles.description: Democrats had an astoundingly good night, smashing all expectations. Is that actually bad news for the industry?

articles.title: Stablecoin growth has stalled. The payments boom hasn't
articles.description: Stablecoin supply has barely grown this year, even as payments using the tokens surge. Circle's latest earnings offer another example of the divergence between dollars outstanding and activity on blockchain networks.

articles.title: These Finland homes get free heat from bitcoin miners (as long as BTC stays above $70,000)
articles.description: A Finnish startup has 30 bitcoin mining systems working as central heating, and at today’s prices each one earns slightly more than the electricity it burns.

articles.title: Binance users in some European countries told to pull crypto before fees kick in, with accounts closing by year end
articles.description: Affected accounts are reportedly set to close on Dec. 31. Users in Spain, France, and Poland say they've received similar notices.

articles.title: U.S. Treasury moves to cut off crypto exchange MEXC over $16 billion in alleged illicit flows
articles.description: Treasury billed the move as part of its campaign against Iran, but the order rests on MEXC's alleged role in Russian illicit finance.

articles.title: Gnosis Pay breach exposes card numbers, home addresses and linked crypto wallets
articles.description: One user said the exposed data tied his home address and card number to every crypto wallet linked to his account, raising the risk of targeted scams.

articles.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
articles.description: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

articles.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
articles.description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

articles.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
articles.description: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

articles.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
articles.description: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

articles.title: U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, blowing past 65,000 estimate
articles.description: The unemployment rate unexpectedly fell to 4.1%. The strong showing surely puts a December rate hike in play, but next week's inflation numbers and the fate of the stock market could prove more important.

articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 6, 2026

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin flatlines under $76,000 as stock bounce loses steam into the close
articles.description: The Nasdaq gained just 1.1%, while the S&P 500 only edged higher, and the DJIA lost more ground.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
articles.description: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.

articles.title: Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
articles.description: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 Friday after dropping below that level during Thursday's tech-driven market rout.

articles.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
articles.description: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.

articles.title: Trump-backed World Liberty Financial plans token buyback after 66% year-to-date slide
articles.description: The crypto venture may use fees from its USD1 stablecoin reserves to fund token purchases as it seeks to boost governance.
